description: Use when there is no API key. Starts an approval request and returns a link. The user opens it, signs in to cloudgpu.app and approves this assistant with a spending limit and a maximum number of GPUs at once; CloudGPU's servers enforce both. Then call finish_connect. No money is spent.

agent_name.description: How the user will recognise this assistant, e.g. 'Claude Code on Yang's laptop'

max_concurrent.description: GPUs or jobs this key may run at once

spend_limit_usd.description: Total this key may ever spend, in USD; ask the user

name: connect_account
title: Connect this assistant to a CloudGPU account
